message: Operation requires auth, but no auth is defined: Fern does not support any of the security schemes in its `security`: sessionCookie (apiKey in cookie). Fern supports apiKey in a header, http bearer, http basic, oauth2 and openIdConnect security schemes.

The root `security` requires auth, but no auth is defined: Fern does not support any of its security schemes: sessionCookie (apiKey in cookie). Fern supports apiKey in a header, http bearer, http basic, oauth2 and openIdConnect security schemes.
